<module id="edge_detect">
    <description>Detects rising and falling edges in the input signal 'a' and outputs corresponding signals 'rise' and 'down'. The edge detection is synchronized with the positive edge of the clock signal 'clk', and the output signals are updated accordingly.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="a">Input signal.</input>
        <output id="rise">Output signal indicating a rising edge.</output>
        <output id="down">Output signal indicating a falling edge.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Register declarations
        reg a_reg;
        reg rise_reg;
        reg down_reg;
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Asynchronous reset
                a_reg <= 1'b0;
                rise_reg <= 1'b0;
                down_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                // Update previous value of a
                a_reg <= a;
                
                // Detect rising edge
                if ((a == 1'b1 && a_reg == 1'b0)) begin
                    rise_reg <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    rise_reg <= 1'b0;
                end
                
                // Detect falling edge
                if ((a == 1'b0 && a_reg == 1'b1)) begin
                    down_reg <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    down_reg <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign output signals
        assign rise = rise_reg;
        assign down = down_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
